notes.title: Tiny quickpatch that fixes one (1) crash
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Thanks so much for your support on this game! This is just a very small patch that fixes one crash that was reported to us over on Discord. Specifically, it fixes an issue with two player mode where the game would crash when both players tried to close/open the building panel at the same time.

That's it! We hope you're having a nice day!!
[i]-PUNKCAKE Délicieux[/i] 🥞

notes.title: 1.3d Quickpatch
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

A few issues were reported to us, some bugs and some mistakes in the game's texts, so here's a little patch fixing these:
[list]
[*]Forcefield capsule now also protects you from kicked blocks.
[*]Tentative fix for a crash related to kicking blocks in unknown but presumably very specific conditions.
[*]Corrected a few typos and rephrased some descriptions.
[*]Pause menu is no longer cut off by the view separator in co-op mode.
[/list]
Thanks for playing Scavenger of Dunomini, we hope you enjoy the game!
Have a nice day!

[i]-PUNKCAKE Délicieux[/i] 🥞
